summary: ExlService Holdings, through its indirect subsidiary Clairvoyant AI, entered a securities purchase agreement to acquire 100% of iMerit for $170M upfront cash (subject to adjustments) plus up to $140M in cash incentives/earnouts over two years. The transaction is expected to close Q3 2026, pending antitrust clearance and customary conditions. The acquirer plans to fund with cash on hand and credit facility. Board approval is implied; no advisor named. Watch for regulatory timing and earnout milestone definitions as risk-arb drivers.
